parsed.post: Latest run 1.024476 regressed from 1.020240, so reverting to LR 0.03. The trend of decreasing LR is still promising, but 0.03 might be hitting the edge of the 5-minute training window. Next, I'll push the LR down to 0.025 to see if we can squeeze more convergence.
